title: Submission #1 held-out reproduction and controlled rule experiments

sample.holdout_definition: SHA256(split_seed + NUL + S1 ID) integer mod 5 == 0; remaining entities are development pool
sample.sample_method: population-proportional stratified bottom-k by match class x country within holdout pool
sample.sample_selection_storage: SQLite temporary file; full ground truth and holdout pool are not retained in Python memory

submission1_rules: same-country exact normalized name+address OR exact normalized name+approved abbreviation-address; only if neither produces a match, emit normalized-name posting iff unique across S2+S3
